reason: I'd use the free first visit for sure, and maybe come once more if my kid loved it. But $15 a visit is a lot when the library and the park are free, and we'd only go once or twice a month, so a membership makes no sense.
objection: Money is tight since daycare went up. $15 for one kid, plus a sibling, adds up fast compared to free storytime and the park, and I'd never go often enough to make unlimited worth it.
would_change_my_mind: A drop-in price around $8 to $10 per kid, or a free-with-purchase deal, would make me come regularly.
